targetTasks.summary: Current window: AlembicPlugin. Claim only task rg7-plugin-create-evolve-immediate-freshness-t1 under stateRoot .wakeflow-active/current/alembic-recipe-evolution-optimization-2026-06-21. Context: RG-7 Core producer is accepted at AlembicCore commit a156e0d796d396e02d815ca22147c83d59bf880b. Core now exposes @alembic/core/knowledge RecipeFreshnessService, SourceRefReconciler.reconcileRecipeSourceRefs(), and RecipeFreshness* result/dependency types. RG-6 vector availability migration is already accepted at AlembicPlugin commit a68b17f6e3b2cdd17e5d31b38df9c0516d2c1e06. Goal: complete the Plugin consumer side of RG-7 timing repair by wiring create/evolve success paths to the accepted Core per-recipe freshness primitive, so new or changed Recipes refresh source_refs and vector state immediately and Plan projection/search can see fresh state without waiting for full rescan. Required behavior: (1) Inspect current Plugin creation/evolution flows first, especially lib/runtime/mcp/handlers/tool-router.ts routeSubmitKnowledgeTool/createSubmitKnowledgeRecipes/buildSubmitKnowledgeResponse, lib/runtime/mcp/handlers/host-agent/evolve.ts evolveForHostAgent, lib/injection/modules/KnowledgeModule.ts initializeKnowledgeServices/_populateSourceRefsForEntry, lib/injection/modules/InfraModule.ts repository/sourceRefReconciler registrations, vectorService registration, and relevant tests. (2) Register or construct the Core RecipeFreshnessService through existing Plugin DI patterns using sourceRefReconciler, recipeSourceRefRepository, and vectorService; do not create a duplicate Plugin-only source_refs parser/upserter. (3) After alembic_submit_knowledge successfully creates Recipes, call the Core freshness service for the created saved entry payloads only, after the save has succeeded and before final response output where feasible. Use created.raw when it contains the saved entry; otherwise load/reconstruct the saved entry through existing repository APIs without guessing. Do not refresh rejected, blocked, duplicate-only, or pending-review-only non-created items. (4) Replace the local KnowledgeModule _populateSourceRefsForEntry event helper or make it delegate to the Core freshness service so local active-only source_ref upserts no longer compete with Core per-recipe reconcile semantics; preserve SearchEngine.refreshIndex behavior. (5) For alembic_evolve, inspect EvolutionGateway outcomes and wire freshness for affected existing Recipes when the gateway outcome mutates, verifies, deprecates, or otherwise updates the Recipe row. If a proposal-only outcome does not modify the Recipe content/state, do not fake a content refresh; return an observable skipped/not-refreshed freshness status and document the boundary in code/tests. Load the affected saved entry from the knowledge repository when the gateway result lacks entry payload. (6) Surface structured freshness output in clean/public MCP responses where useful: per created/affected recipe freshness status, retrievalMayBeStale, vector availability/degraded reason, and sourceRef/vector summaries bounded enough for existing clean-output conventions. Existing four public MCP business semantics must remain intact; new freshness fields should be additive/diagnostic. (7) Ensure create-after-submit immediate search/prime readiness path is genuinely improved: source_refs are reconciled per affected recipe, vector entry/regions are refreshed through Core availability gates, and degraded vector provider state is observable rather than silently successful. (8) Add tests covering successful submit freshness call with active/stale/dropped refs, degraded vector availability output, no duplicate local _populateSourceRefsForEntry active-only behavior, evolve affected-recipe freshness behavior, proposal-only evolve boundary if applicable, and existing clean-output/public-output contracts. Boundaries: do not edit AlembicCore except for a minimal compile follow-up if the accepted public API is unusable; do not implement RG-8 commit-driven unified evolution, git diff/rename/new-module routing, rescan catch-up, commit merge-base handling, RG-9 cleanup, RG-10 BiliDili scenario, daemon/watch behavior, Test delivery, or deletion of evidence/proposal/vector structures. Do not create Plugin-local Plan/generation state or double-write Plan projection. If Core API is insufficient for real Plugin wiring, return blocked/needs-review with raw evidence and the smallest Core repair requested. Expected validation: npm run build:check; targeted Plugin tests for submit/evolve freshness and KnowledgeModule DI/event behavior; MCP clean-output/public contract tests touched by new freshness fields; existing RG-4/RG-5 Plan/ProjectContext anchored generation tests if outputs are touched; npm run lint; npm run lint:core-import-boundary; npm run lint:repo-boundary; npm run lint:layer-boundary; npm run verify:release-package-boundary; git diff --check; Alembic Guard over changed files. Return TargetResultEnvelope with commit hash, changed files, exact validation output, risks, and notes for RG-8 eligibility.
